title: L109 — THE TOLL NOBODY COUNTS
voice: You entered a trade at the price you wanted, and you left at the price you wanted, and somehow the account shrank.
The spread is the gap between the price you see and the price you get, and it collects on every single trade you take.
On a quiet pair, the toll is small, but on a volatile session, the gap widens right when you need it least.
A hundred trades at two pips of spread cost the same as one blown stop.
Count the toll before you count the win. Follow KONGRAVE — the mechanics nobody explains.
